-10.1% day-over-day move (z-score -5.06), on top of -22.7% over the last 10 trading days on 2020-03-06. Reasons given by 4 reports from that day:
- "Crude Oil Prices : Crude oil prices plunge over 5 % on Opec reports , coronavirus" (economictimes.indiatimes.com, 2020-03-06). Reported move: down 5%. Reason: Opec reports , coronavirus. Quote: "Brent and WTI crude futures tumbled by nearly $3 a barrel, or more than 5%, after the report." (source: 1f0933869f0576ab)
- "Oil prices plunge over 5 % on OPEC reports , coronavirus" (thehindu.com, 2020-03-06). Reported move: down 5%. Reason: reports that Russia wants to delay deeper output cuts recommended by its OPEC allies. Quote: "extended losses to more than 5% on Friday on reports that Russia wants to delay deeper output cuts" (source: 3fc7f8e83e45897e)
- "Oil Prices Plunge over 5 % on OPEC Reports , Coronavirus Outbreak" (news18.com, 2020-03-06). Reported move: down 5%. Reason: reports that Russia wants to delay deeper output cuts recommended by its OPEC allies. Quote: "extended losses to more than 5% on Friday on reports that Russia wants to delay deeper output cuts" (source: 0542c00d2fbfe5ea)
- "World oil prices plunge over 7 . 5 %" (business-standard.com, 2020-03-06). Reported move: down 7.5%. Reason: talks between OPEC and Russia over a possible cut in output ... ended without a deal. Quote: "talks between OPEC and Russia over a possible cut in output in response to a coronavirus-fulled slump in demand ended without a deal" (source: 2cca61d5a8859903)
